title: Innovation Engineer – Rapid Prototyping (f/m/d)
description:
Our innovation lab tests new product ideas with customers within weeks.

What you'll do
- Build quick functional models of automation components
- Use 3D printing, Arduino and Raspberry Pi to simulate concepts
- Present prototypes at customer workshops and collect feedback

What you bring
- Degree in mechatronics, engineering or a related field
- 1-2 years of experience in prototyping or R&D
- Applicants must already hold a valid work permit for Germany; we cannot sponsor visas or relocation
- Good English
